epic.title: Epic: the door is the interface — finish the MCP migration (#567)
epic.intent_and_why: One interface for agents: the MCP door. The CLI becomes an operator and debug path only. The outcome that must not be violated is that this epic reduces complexity by removing a redundant path.

definition_of_done: A dispatched crew drives its own spine through the door end to end.
No agent-facing file teaches the CLI as a path for agents.
A guard refuses reintroduction of the CLI-fallback text.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: The merge gate is the full suite green on Linux in a clean detached worktree of the branch, never a working copy. Engine and hook behaviour is validated in a fresh process with explicit paths.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Behaviour-level red-proofs against the shipped path rather than a fixture, plus a re-verify of main after each merge.
good_enough.appetite: Two waves planned; a third added by the human after wave 2.

hard_constraints: No lane files an issue during the run.
No lane promotes an observation into docs/agents/*.
Design work is never dispatched as a fork.
Every dispatch and every crew passes --model explicitly.
fixed_decisions: Wave-1 and wave-2 lane identities remain stable and their branches are merged and kept (#412).
The workbench directory stays a template-only package; the four templates do not move.
#574's PR-opening question stays reserved for the human.

current_wave.objective: Subtract the redundant path now that the door reaches the caller's own spine.
exit_criteria: Zero CLI fallback clauses and zero live agent-facing <engine> tokens remain, and a guard fails if either returns.
The workbench teaching half is gone and every role spine still starts.
Lanes E, F and H each return a merged green PR or an evidenced honest null.
main is re-verified green after the last merge.

issues.title: The complete doctrine sweep and the regrowth guard (#559, with #596 and #526)
issues.desired_outcome: No agent-facing instruction names the CLI as a path for agents, and a guard fails if any of it returns.
issues.useful_now: The door now reaches the caller's own spine, so the fallback is genuinely redundant for the first time.
issues.appetite: One Commander at Opus tier. The guard is the deliverable, not the deletion.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A red-proof of the guard: reintroduce a clause and a token, show the guard fails, remove them, show it passes.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the guard's mechanism, its scope expression, and the replacement wording.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not touch skills/workbench/** -- lane D2's file set.
Do not edit docs/superpowers/** -- historical records.
local_unknowns: Whether the guard belongs with the retirement-guard family or as its own module.

issues.title: Sunset the workbench teaching half and keep the directory as a template-only package (#565, with #561)
issues.desired_outcome: The teaching half is gone, workbench is no longer a taught skill, and the four templates still resolve at their existing paths.
issues.useful_now: The CLI text kept growing back because teaching an agent to drive the engine is what this skill was for, and that job moved to the door.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: Establish, do not assume, that the door's tool descriptions carry what the two references carried, and name anything they do not.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose how workbench is deregistered and the replacement wording.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not move any of the four templates.
local_unknowns: Whether deregistering a skill that still ships templates is a supported state.

issues.title: Door rejections captured as episode friction (#541)
issues.desired_outcome: A door refusal lands in the run's episode record instead of vanishing.
issues.useful_now: The door hides the friction the CLI used to surface.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A real refusal, triggered in a fresh process, read back out of the store, with a negative control.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose which refusals are captured and the record's shape.
hard_constraints_no_gos: episodes/ has one write path, apply_episode_delta.py.
local_unknowns: Whether a refusal with no bound spine has any work-id to attribute to.

issues.title: Reveal the spec through the spine, not the launch order (#535)
issues.desired_outcome: A dispatch starts with an identifier and the spine reveals the spec.
issues.useful_now: Wave 1's worst failure was a lane that could not get past the bootstrap floor a launch order opens with.
issues.appetite: One Commander at Sonnet tier, measure-first.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A dispatch driven from an identifier alone reaches its first gate with the spec available; an evidenced honest null is complete.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose how much of the launch order the spine absorbs.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Measure the existing spine_open spec compilation first.
local_unknowns: How much of #535 wave 1 already delivered.

issues.title: The rail and the HARD refusal remedy read to the agent they are aimed at (#442)
issues.desired_outcome: A cold agent shown only the rail and a HARD refusal can state what it is being asked to do and do it.
issues.useful_now: Agents read the RAIL banner as possible prompt injection and discount the instruction it carries.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: Measured on real cold agents, not judged by the author.
issues.implementation_latitude: Rewrite the strings; choose the measurement's shape.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not redesign the trip mechanic.
local_unknowns: Whether a cold-agent measurement fits a Sonnet lane's budget.
